Claims Department

Re: Claim C-1097
Our client: Todd Lee
Date of loss: 2023-08-13
Dear Claims Representative:
This firm represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end collision involving a vehicle insured
under your policy. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our
client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person. If your insured or any representative has already been in
contact with our client, please let us know so that we can address it.
We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits of the policy in force at the time of the accident, along with
a certified copy of the declarations page and a statement of any other coverage that may apply to this loss. Please
also cofnirm the name of the adjuster assigned to this claim.
We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file,
photographs, recorded statements, vehicle repair and total-loss records, telematics or event data recorder
information, dash camera footage, and all correspondence with your insured. Please suspend any routine deletion or
disposal procedures that could affect these materials.
Please acknowledge receipt of this letter within fourteen days.
Sincerely,
Garrett Wallace
Gardner & Morris Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
